summary: Complete and adjudicate the same frozen selector-v7 fixed-15 task with DeepSeek Flash and V4 Pro, and align the readiness schema with selector-v7 reason output.
decision_refs: Both profiles used run RUN-6322ca9598a74c768c91117a7fa05834, snapshot SN-051a40d964a10ccf640a9710233de205, question hash 2d29ad029e36e7fb8af97ae6917774811c06094f4b4b4b2ab80915543cdec755 and literal-page-selector-7.
Flash produced 9 contract-valid and 7 fully usable items; Pro produced 12 contract-valid and 9 fully usable items. Both failed the fixed release gate.
A readiness 500 was caused by QUESTION_ENTITY_MATCH being absent from the public enum even though selector v7 emitted it; the schema and zero-call regression were corrected.
Historical verification note: readiness reason-code regression and selector tests
Historical verification note: same-identity Flash/Pro managed evaluation jobs with explicit confirmation
Historical verification note: manual adjudication and zero-call scorecards for all 30 terminal items
Historical verification note: full Python, localization, spec, change and bundle gates
approval_evidence: The user explicitly allowed API calls and directed CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue.
known_limitations: The full evaluations use the prompt contract that preceded DEV-168 calculation guidance; they are the v7 baseline, not a post-DEV-168 final comparison.
Pro improved over Flash but remained below both the 15 contract-valid and 12 fully-usable thresholds.
Neither model is approved for unattended release and the comparison endpoint does not infer a winner.
